summary_en: SPARX Group authorized acquisition of up to 185,000 shares (0.45% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥500 million from November 2 to December 30, 2026, with all acquired shares to be cancelled on December 31, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
SPARX Group's board of directors resolved on October 30, 2026, to acquire treasury stock and subsequently cancel it. The company will acquire up to 185,000 shares of its ordinary stock, representing 0.45% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum consideration of ¥500 million. The acquisition period runs from November 2, 2026, to December 30, 2026. All shares acquired under this program will be cancelled on December 31, 2026.

The company stated that it undertakes this capital allocation to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency while maintaining stable and continuous dividends. The decision reflects careful consideration of appropriate cash reserves, investment plans for future growth, and performance-based compensation, among other factors. By reducing the total number of issued shares, the company aims to improve capital efficiency and share value on a per-share basis.
